title: Two Thousand Years of Earth and Brick: How the Great Wall Was Built
title_zh: 两千年的土与砖：长城是如何建成的
intro_zh: 本文约 557 词，按时间顺序讲述长城从战国土墙到明代砖石城墙的两千多年建造史，含 6 个 CET-4 核心词，句子难度适中，适合四级阅读训练。

paragraphs.en: Ask people to name the longest structure ever built, and most will answer at once: the Great Wall of China. Its sections and branches stretch more than 21,000 kilometres. Yet no one, not even an emperor, ever saw the whole wall at once. It was raised piece by piece over roughly two thousand years, by many rulers, for many different reasons.
paragraphs.zh: 如果请人们说出人类建过的最长建筑，多数人会脱口而出：中国长城。它的各段墙体与支线绵延两万多公里。然而，从来没有一个人——哪怕是皇帝——在同一时刻看到过整条长城。它是两千多年间由许多统治者、出于种种不同原因，一段一段垒起来的。

paragraphs.en: The story began long before China was a single country. From about the seventh century BC, small kingdoms in the north piled up banks of earth to slow down horsemen from the grasslands. These early walls were low, cheap and local. They were also separate: one farmer's field might lie between two walls that belonged to two enemies.
paragraphs.zh: 这个故事早在中国成为一个统一国家之前就开始了。大约从公元前七世纪起，北方的小国便堆起一道道土墙，用来减缓草原骑兵的冲击。这些早期的墙又低、又省钱，也只护一方。它们彼此孤立：一个农夫的田地，可能正好夹在属于两个敌对国家的两道墙之间。

paragraphs.en: In 221 BC, Qin Shi Huang defeated the last of his rivals and became the first emperor of a united China. He ordered his generals to link the strongest northern walls into one long line. Hundreds of thousands of workers — soldiers, farmers and prisoners — were marched north with picks and baskets. They had no cement; they pressed earth between wooden frames until it dried as hard as stone. The labor was brutal, and many never came home. The Qin wall stretched about 5,000 kilometres.
paragraphs.zh: 公元前 221 年，秦始皇击败了最后一个对手，成为统一中国的第一位皇帝。他命将领们把北方最坚固的城墙连接成一条长线。数十万劳工——士兵、农民和囚犯——带着镐和筐被派往北方。他们没有水泥，只能把泥土层层压在木框之间，直到干得像石头一样硬。这种劳动极其残酷，许多人再也没能回家。秦长城延伸约五千公里。

paragraphs.en: Later dynasties repeated the idea. From 206 BC, the Han pushed walls far west into the Gobi Desert and added watchtowers every few kilometres. Guards on those towers sent smoke signals by day and fire by night. A warning could travel hundreds of kilometres in a few hours, so the wall worked less as a fence than as an early warning network.
paragraphs.zh: 后来的各个朝代重复了这一做法。从公元前 206 年起，汉朝把城墙向西一直修进戈壁沙漠，并每隔几公里增设一座烽火台。台上的守兵白天放烟、夜里点火。一条警报几个小时就能传出数百公里，因此这道墙与其说是栅栏，不如说是一套早期预警网络。

paragraphs.en: Then the work largely stopped. For several centuries, Chinese rulers looked west along the trade routes and trusted treaties more than bricks. Long stretches of the old walls crumbled back into the soil, and farmers took the stones for their houses and the earth for their fields.
paragraphs.zh: 此后大规模修建基本停了下来。有好几个世纪，中国的统治者把目光投向西方的商路，更相信条约而不是砖石。旧墙的大段墙体崩塌，重新回到泥土里，农夫们取走石块盖房，挖走泥土种地。

paragraphs.en: Everything changed under the Ming, who ruled from 1368 to 1644. Facing horsemen who threatened to invade from the north, Ming emperors ordered the largest rebuilding in history. This time the walls were faced with brick and cut stone, held together with a mortar of sticky rice soup and lime, a mixture so strong that parts of it still hold today. The result is the wall most visitors photograph: about 8,850 kilometres of solid wall.
paragraphs.zh: 到了明朝（1368—1644 年统治中国），一切都变了。面对威胁要从北方入侵的骑兵，明朝皇帝下令进行历史上规模最大的重建。这一次，城墙外面砌上砖和凿好的石头，用糯米汤加石灰调成的灰浆黏合——这种混合物极其坚固，有些地方至今仍然牢固。游客们拍照留念的那道长城，就是这约 8850 公里的实心城墙。

paragraphs.en: Building it was a nightmare of logistics. Bricks were fired in kilns within a few kilometres of each section, because transport was the hardest job of all. On flat ground, workers used carts, donkeys and wheelbarrows. On steep ridges, ropes, baskets and human backs did the work. Work stopped in the freezing winter and started again in spring.
paragraphs.zh: 修建它的后勤工作堪称噩梦。砖都在离每段城墙只有几公里的窑里烧制，因为运输是最艰巨的活儿。在平地上，工人们用推车、驴子和独轮车；在陡峭的山脊上，绳子、筐子和人的背脊承担了全部工作。工程在严寒的冬天停工，到春天再重新开始。

paragraphs.en: Did the wall really defend China? Partly. It slowed small raiding parties, gave advance warning, and let the government control trade at the gates. But no wall can stop an enemy who is determined to find a way through, around or over it. The Mongols rode past the wall in the thirteenth century, and the Manchus crossed it in 1644.
paragraphs.zh: 长城真的保卫了中国吗？部分是。它拖慢了小股劫掠队伍，提供了预警，还让政府在关口控制贸易。但再高的墙也挡不住一个决心找路穿过去、绕过去或翻过去的敌人。十三世纪，蒙古人从墙外绕过；1644 年，满人越墙而入。

paragraphs.en: So the Great Wall is not one wall but many, and not a single victory but a long argument between people and landscape. In 1987 UNESCO listed it as a World Heritage Site. Millions of people visit it every year. What they see is not only stone; it is the record of generations of workers whose names were never written down.
paragraphs.zh: 所以，长城不是一道墙，而是许多道墙；不是一场胜利，而是人与大地之间漫长的角力。1987 年，联合国教科文组织将它列入世界遗产名录。每年有数百万人前来参观。他们看到的不仅是石头，更是一代代工人留下的记录——而他们的名字从未被记下。

questions.q: What is the main idea of the passage?
options: The Great Wall was designed and finished by one emperor in a single lifetime.
The Great Wall is a single wall that has never been repaired.
The Great Wall was built and rebuilt by many rulers over about two thousand years.
The Great Wall was built mainly for tourists to visit.
questions.explain: 文章按时间顺序讲了战国土墙、秦朝连接、汉朝西延、明代砖石重建，反复强调它是两千多年间多个朝代多次修建的结果，故选 C。A 与第一段「piece by piece over roughly two thousand years」矛盾；B 与文中反复重建不符；D 因果颠倒，旅游是今天的结果而非建造目的。

questions.q: How did soldiers on Han watchtowers send warnings?
options: By riding horses from tower to tower.
By using smoke in the daytime and fire at night.
By playing drums made of animal skin.
By writing letters to the capital.
questions.explain: 第四段明确说 guards sent smoke signals by day and fire by night，即白天放烟、夜里点火，把警报一站站传下去，故选 B。其余选项文中均未提及。

questions.q: The word 'crumbled' in Paragraph 5 is closest in meaning to ______.
questions.explain: 第五段说旧墙长期无人修缮，还被人取石取土，说明墙体崩塌碎裂、重归泥土，故 crumbled 意为「碎裂、崩塌」，选 A。

questions.q: What can be inferred about the Great Wall as a defence?
options: It made any attack on China completely impossible.
It was useful mainly for warning and controlling movement rather than as a solid barrier.
It was never crossed by any enemy.
It was built only to protect trade caravans.
questions.explain: 第八段指出它减缓小股劫掠、提供预警、控制关口贸易，但决心进攻的敌人可以绕过或翻过（蒙古人、满人即是例证），可见其价值重在预警与控制通行，而非绝对屏障，故选 B。A、C 与文意相反，D 过于绝对。
